newsitem.title: UK: Receivers appointed to UK's Wakebourne.
newsitem.headline: Receivers appointed to UK's Wakebourne.

text.p: British business systems firm Wakebourne Plc said on Tuesday two partners of Ernst & Young had been appointed joint administrative receivers to the firm.
Wakebourne said it would continue to do business while the receivers investigated the company's affairs and sought buyers for its businesses.
One of the joint receivers, Jason Elles, said he had been contacted by a number of companies expressing interest in purchasing all or part of the assets of the group.
"I am hopeful of making rapid progress," he said.
Trading in its shares were suspended on May 12 when it announced it was in advanced discussions that could lead to an offer for the company.
